name: Weekly rank cap
details: Beta data shows the highest rank reachable each week of a season: week 1 rank 3, week 2 rank 5, week 3 rank 6, week 4 rank 7, week 5 rank 8, week 6 rank 9, week 7 rank 11, week 8 rank 12, week 9 rank 13, week 10+ rank 14. Blizzard confirmed a weekly cap but not these exact numbers.

name: Honor
details: Currency earned from honorable kills, battleground results and PvP quests. Spent on gear; it does not decay. Honor gains were rebalanced so Alterac Valley is no longer the only efficient farm, and featured battlegrounds during holiday weeks give more.

name: Rank Points
details: Separate currency that drives rank. Earned from battlegrounds, PvP quests and honorable kills (not from ganking in the open world), boosted in featured battlegrounds.

name: Blue PvP armour set
details: Rare-quality PvP set bought with Honor, gated by rank. Shamans get dedicated healer, melee and caster sets.
requirements: Honor plus the required rank

name: Epic PvP armour (Emboldened Seal upgrade)
details: Epic pieces are made by combining the blue piece with an Emboldened Seal, bought with Honor and gated behind higher ranks (ranks 8-13 unlock the slot tokens).
requirements: Blue piece + Emboldened Seal + rank requirement

name: Rank 14 epic weapons
details: Reaching Grand Marshal / High Warlord unlocks the epic PvP weapons; Blizzard says rank 14 is reachable within one season.
requirements: Rank 14

name: Marks of Honor
details: Earned by turning in battleground reputation quests; can be handed in for battleground reputation.

name: Battle for the Darkspear Islands
details: New 15v15 battleground off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh. Four capture points generate score over time and a central flag carried to a base you hold gives a bonus; first to 2,000 wins. Horde fight as the Darkspear Raiders (base at Merchant Coast), Alliance as the Theramore Expeditionary Force (base at Northwatch); both bases have portals, vendors and quests. Queue from battlemasters in capitals or The Barrens.
requirements: Levels 30-60
rewards: Darkspear Raiders / Theramore Expeditionary Force reputation
Trinkets, rings, cloaks, weapons and armour by standing

name: Warsong Gulch
details: 10v10 capture-the-flag in Ashenvale; returns at launch.
requirements: Brackets not announced

name: Arathi Basin
details: 15v15 resource race over five nodes in Arathi Highlands; returns at launch.
requirements: Brackets not announced

name: Alterac Valley
details: 40v40 large-scale battle in Alterac Mountains; returns at launch with honor rebalanced against other battlegrounds.
requirements: Brackets not announced

name: PvP realms
details: Open-world PvP is always on and each PvP realm is locked to a single faction. Rank only comes from battlegrounds, PvP quests and honorable kills, not from ganking.

name: Normal realms
details: PvP is consensual (flag up to fight) and both factions can play on the same realm. Battlegrounds mix players across rulesets except Hardcore, which queues separately.

name: Field of Honor season journey
details: Each PvP season has a progression track of weekly quests that give Honor, Rank Points and Legacy Points. Completing the week 4, week 7 and week 10 quests gives a Legacy Point each (3 per season). Rank progress resets each season or content patch; Legacy Points carry over. Season length not announced. No rated PvP or arenas announced.

name: PvP Legacy challenges
details: Account-wide Legacy challenges for reaching ranks 3, 7, 10, 13 and 14, and for Exalted with your Darkspear Islands faction.
